about: UsdLux, as OpenUSD's schemas define it: the attributes every light has (LightAPI) and each type's own, with their fallback values. Imago lays the Light operator's parameters out from this file and writes them as they are named here.

common.name: inputs:intensity
common.label: Intensity
common.help: How bright it is, before exposure.

common.name: inputs:exposure
common.label: Exposure
common.help: Stops: each one doubles the intensity.

common.name: inputs:color
common.label: Colour
common.help: The light's colour, multiplied by its temperature's when that is on.

common.name: inputs:enableColorTemperature
common.label: Use Temperature
common.help: Colour it by a blackbody temperature as well.

common.name: inputs:colorTemperature
common.label: Temperature
common.help: Kelvin: 6500 is white (D65), lower is warmer, higher cooler.

common.name: inputs:normalize
common.label: Normalize
common.help: Divide the power by the light's area, so its size does not change how bright it is.

common.name: inputs:diffuse
common.label: Diffuse
common.help: A multiplier on what it gives diffuse surfaces.

common.name: inputs:specular
common.label: Specular
common.help: A multiplier on what it gives specular reflections.

params.name: inputs:texture:file
params.label: Texture
params.help: An environment image, usually an HDR (EXR, HDR): light from every direction.

params.name: inputs:texture:format
params.label: Format
params.help: How the image maps onto the sphere. Automatic goes by its aspect.

params.name: poleAxis
params.label: Pole Axis
params.help: Which axis the image's poles are on: the stage's up axis, Y or Z.

params.name: guideRadius
params.label: Guide Radius
params.help: How big it is drawn, in scene units. Not how it lights.

params.name: inputs:width
params.label: Width
params.help: Along its X axis. It emits along -Z, from one side.

params.name: inputs:texture:file
params.label: Texture
params.help: An image on the rectangle, colouring what it emits.

params.name: treatAsPoint
params.label: Treat as Point
params.help: A point light: a sphere of no size, where the renderer can do one.

params.name: inputs:radius
params.label: Radius
params.help: The disk's radius, in its XY plane. It emits along -Z.

params.name: treatAsLine
params.label: Treat as Line
params.help: A line light: a cylinder of no radius, where the renderer can do one.

params.name: inputs:angle
params.label: Angle
params.help: Degrees across the source as seen from the scene: 0.53 is the sun's. It shines along -Z.
